We are the place where non-violent resistance begins.

ethical-code.title: Кодекс этики
content: Our code of ethics

Операции FreeCause осуществляются в соответствии с ценностями и принципами, изложенными в нашем этическом коде, которая служит вдохновением для каждого представителя компании, Сотрудник и внешнего партнера .
Although newly established, by adhering to this code, we have grown to become the world’s leading platform for petition collection.
We are based in London, but through people, we want to change the world. Our mission is to give voice to causes that matter.

Our vision is to change the world—a goal we may not always achieve, but one that drives us forward. Our online signature collections have proven to be effective tools for amplifying voices and ensuring they are heard. Nothing matches the speed and reach of the internet in this regard.

With this Code of Ethics, the FreeCause network formally adopts the principles of legitimacy, integrity, transparency, and verifiability as its guiding standards. This code establishes the primary rules to be followed by representatives, employees, and external partners, all of whom are expected to carry out their duties with professionalism, diligence, and honesty. Their actions must align with the best interests of the company, its clients, and the broader community of users. Decision-making and all related activities are subject to these values and principles. The company carefully selects its partners based on their alignment with these values, whether they are individuals or organizations. Noncompliance with this code constitutes a breach of ethical obligations and an act of dishonesty toward the company.

FreeCause does not accept financial contributions from governments or associations. Our only source of financial support comes from advertisements displayed on our web pages. These advertisements are managed by reputable third-party partners, such as Google Inc., who align with our values. These are display advertisements only and do not share any user information—similar to commercials seen on television.
We will never share user data with external companies. Those who sign petitions provide their names to support causes they believe in, not to give us their personal data.

By following our Code of Ethics, we have established strong partnerships with nonprofit organizations, NGOs, and everyday citizens around the world. We are the starting point for nonviolent advocacy efforts.
Ethical Code

FreeCause operates in the field of online petition collection. Our business model is built on upholding high ethical values, such as full compliance with the law, respect for workers and their rights, and fair competition among industry peers. Remaining true to our founding principles, FreeCause is committed to honesty, transparency, discretion, security, and fair competition. This Code of Conduct serves as a benchmark for all individuals contributing to FreeCause, particularly those in leadership roles.
Принципы:
Доверие

FreeCause's success is rooted in mutual trust among all stakeholders who contribute daily to the company, including clients, employees, representatives, and partners. This trust is built upon a shared mission, adherence to our values, and strict compliance with this code. A lack of respect for these principles at any level is incompatible with FreeCause’s mission. Therefore, mutual respect is essential and fosters a culture of cooperation, characterized by professionalism, ethical behavior, and courteous interactions both within the company and externally.
Людские ресурсы

оценивая нашу ценность наших людских ресурсов, уважая их независимость, и поощрение их участия в решении компании являются основными принципами FreeCause. Мы обеспечиваем программы обучения и развития для повышать профессиональные навыки и помогать сотрудникам в их карьерном росте.
Honesty

FreeCause ensures that all members, employees, and partners understand the ethical implications of their actions and do not seek personal or corporate gain at the expense of legal compliance and ethical conduct. Employees and partners must never offer illicit benefits to clients or service providers. Furthermore, conflicts of interest must be avoided, ensuring that no individual benefits improperly from company dealings.
Transparency

FreeCause is committed to maintaining a clear, accurate, and comprehensive portrayal of its business operations. We provide complete and transparent information regarding the principles guiding our social mission.
Конфиденциальность

Due to the nature of our operations, FreeCause ensures that all employees and partners protect users' privacy. We safeguard personal information in compliance with applicable privacy laws and use collected data solely for the intended purpose of petition-related activities. Only authorized personnel have access to such information, and all processing activities are conducted securely. Employees, members, and company representatives strictly adhere to privacy laws and confidentiality standards.
Fairness

FreeCause requires all members, employees, and partners to act with fairness and integrity, avoiding opportunistic or discriminatory behavior. As an equal opportunity employer, FreeCause does not discriminate based on race, color, age, gender, disability, or any other characteristic.
Health and Safety in the Workplace

FreeCause ensures that all employees and partners comply with safety measures in line with technological advancements. We are committed to safeguarding the physical and moral well-being of our employees and fostering a safe work environment.

faqs.title: Фак
content: General Information
Полезны онлайн-петиции?

"Online" petitions can be an effective way to seek support for an issue or to get attention on a certain question. Many of the petitions that we host have collected hundreds of thousands of signatures. Those who were the recipients of these petitions have been forced to take note of the public will and to resolve the problem. However, because a petition could be effective, and because it could be created actually a change, you need to activate yourself to promote your petition. You should send email to your friends and colleagues, and thus to promote the petition in discussion groups and other public websites, where users may be interested in your same problem. Many web campaigns have changed in a positive way the life of small communities and countries. Nothing has the strength popularization as Internet, we raise the volume of your voice.
Почему вместо этого вы должны предпочитать онлайн-петицию на бумаге?

First, because an online petition can be accessed in seconds by hundreds of millions of people through the internet and around the world. Just give to your friends the address FreeCause and from that moment your petition will be spread across the globe. From that moment you'll be an activist in the globalized world.
Do you have th intention to make a paper petition? Do you prefer to stay on a street corner to collect signatures? At most you will be able to collect several hundred signatures and have sore legs.
Secondly, you can use online marketing to get more users willing to sign. Each visitor to your petition may invite a friend to sign the petition.
The great mass of people on the internet will make your voice heard around the world!
Можно ли использовать FreeCause для предложений о референдуме?

Yes, if accompanied by documentation of the signatories. In addition, a campaign on FreeCause can also have an effect on governments and politicians. Many of our demands are addressed to individuals or institutions and governments. Although not legally bound, they have an impact on public opinion in an important way.
We give voice to an idea, many campaigns started from FreeCause have moved governments.
Как мне получить больше информации о FreeCause?
To learn more, go to our website and visit the Information page and our Ethical Code.
Tips on how to subscribe. For example, what it should be done if the system doesn't accept your email address or password you typed?

Для регистрации, просто укажите имя, ваш адрес электронной почты и пароль. Если ваш адрес электронной почты, по какой-то причине он уже находится в нашей базе данных, запись не может продолжаться. В нашей базе данных ваш адрес электронной почты может появиться и может быть связан только с одной регистрацией. После отправки данных, вам нужно будет дождаться активации письма, содержащего ссылку, чтобы доказать, что вы истинный владелец используемого адреса электронной почты. Если у вас есть учетная запись Facebook, Google или Twitter, вы можете получить доступ очень просто, нажав на соответствующую кнопку.
For signatories of a petition
FreeCause apparently sent me an email, but I have not received it. Why?

Возможно, ваш почтовый провайдер отметил сообщение как спам. Мы рекомендуем вам изменить настройки или фильтр спама и вставить FreeCause в список доверенных адресов. Мы не отправляем письма без необходимости и это является гарантией для вас, потому что мы связываемся только с вами для сообщения информации конкретной актуальности.
Гарантирует ли конфиденциальность моих персональных данных?

FreeCause will treat your personal data very seriously. After signing a petition, you will receive an email confirmation stating that your signature has been recorded. FreeCause will not use your information and your email for other petitions or for other purposes, unless you authorize us to do it. In any case, we pledge to not disclose to third parties your personal information. The only person who will be aware that you have signed the petition is the host or the person who made the petition that you have decided to sign. Read also our Ethical Code.
Как я узнаю, что петиция, которую я подписал, прошла успешно?

There are many ways to follow the progress and know if the petition you've signed has been successful. A good way is to visit the site where the petition is online regularly. There you will certainly find news and updates.
Как мне сообщить, когда петиция нарушает соблюдение закона о ее содержании?

FreeCause accept any complaints very seriously, and if is found that a petition contains content that violates the law, please contact us immediately. Before proceeding, you must ensure that the content is really illegal and that simply does not respond to our ideas about the subject matter of the petition itself. Our business ethics requires us also accept that there are different ideas from those proposed by the petition, in that case, please express your opposition to creating a counter-petition or commenting on the special space in the same comments.
Как мне создать петицию?

If you just signed a campaign to collect signatures and would like to create your own, we are happy to inform you that we offer the most advanced and flexible tools to create petitions on the web. Enter here
to create a petition.
What happened to my signature? I signed a petition, but I can't find it in the list of signatories.

We divide the list of signatories in more than one page, even if in the pages after the first you can't find the signature, contact the staff indicating the petition and email address associated with your account. We will be happy to help you.
I signed a petition. My data and my personal information will be treated confidentially?
Yes. We have our safety and privacy code. Please read our privacy code.
Меня зовут на вашем сайте или Google. Как я могу его удалить?

Please contact the Staff of FreeCause and ask them to remove your name from the petition. If someone has entered your name in a list or forum without your permission, please contact the sponsor of the petition and ask him to immediately remove you. FreeCause can't absolutely exercise any control over the use of your name by third parties, however we will activate immediately in case of we recieve complaints. Please read the Terms of Use of FreeCause. When your name has been removed of FreeCause, please visit the list with the signatures to verify that indeed has been done. Although has been removed, however, Google will continue to index it. In fact, the process of updating the new data will require a few days. Your name will appear on Google for a few days until the search engine will not have completed the upgrade.
Facebook and Twitter statistics. Why Facebook users prefer to click "like" and not sign? What happened to the "like" of facebook?

Often a petition recieve more likes than signatures. This may happen because some people prefer to just click on "I like" and not to sign, for privacy or personal reasons. Some who share the objectives of a petition, don't want to give their information and so prefer not to sign but only click on "I like it." The fact that there are more "like" does not mean you've lost signatures. It just means that you have a broader support. But remember that if you change the URL of your petition you will also lose all those users who have expressed an interest in your idea. However, you can have others or redirect the old URL to the new.
Могу ли я скрыть петицию из публичных каталогов или Google? Могу ли я внести изменения?
No, you can't hide the petition, it will be indexed by Google in the days following the creation. Also you can make changes only if no one, apart of the promoter, has not yet signed.
Часовой пояс. Какой часовой пояс используется для датирования подписей?
FreeCause использует UTC-5
Как я могу закрыть свой аккаунт FreeCause? Закрытие аккаунта.

Вы можете отменить свой аккаунт в любое время, как только у вас будет доступ, перейдите в свой профиль, , вы найдёте кнопку, которая удалит ваш аккаунт и все данные, связанные с ним из нашей базы данных.
If you have questions or concerns please contact us, maybe we can help you.
Our community is based on trust between users and those who run the service for users.
For promoters of petitions
How do I activate my membership once I decided to start a campaign?
When you subscribe to FreeCause, we send a message to your email address to confirm your account.
If you have not received the activation email, you can request it by clicking the link on the login screen, it is questo. If you have problems with the activation process, contact us.
Свободно ли создание петиции?

Yes, all our petitions are absolutely free. We offer the most flexible and advanced tools on the web, and we support through advertising and voluntary donations. You can also create a petition requesting that a paid service becomes free.
Мне нужны технические знания для создания петиции?
Для создания онлайн-петиции вам не требуется никаких технических знаний.
All is already provided by FreeCause, you will only express your ideas.
Могу ли я импортировать петицию на ваш сайт, которая была открыта на другом сайте?
Yes. Simply integrate with our existing database, and we will help transfer the petition on our website. Contact us to do this, we will help you on it.
Могу ли я выбрать графический стиль моей петиции?
We are implementing a service that will allow you to customize it. It will be possible shortly to customize the new petitions or those already created.
Могу ли я добавить несколько петиций?
Yes, of course, personal freedom has no limits.
FreeCause will use the information and signatures I gathered, for other purposes?

FreeCause treats privacy very seriously. The list of signatures will not be used under any circumstances, except to send the confirmation email to the signatory of a petition or if the petitioner authorize us to contact others for petitions or other related events. Only in this case we can contact the complainant. In no cases we shall sell, trade or share signatory information with third parties. To learn more about privacy read also our code of ethics.
Enter to read our Ethical Code.
Можно ли подать мою петицию в "Рекомендуемые петиции" или на домашней странице FreeCause?
В окне петиции, выделенной на окно, становится более видимым, что увеличивает количество получаемых подписей. Если вы хотите, чтобы ваше ходатайство было помещено в окно, то contattaci.
Как я могу удалить петицию?
Для удаления петиции вы можете использовать ссылку Удалить на странице петиции. Вы должны войти для выполнения этой операции.
Я создал петицию, но не могу ее найти. Где моя петиция?
Используйте функцию поиска или введите страницу вашего профиля, внутри профиля вы найдете список ваших петиций, которые вы открыли.
Что лучший способ написать петицию?
Мы рекомендуем вам прочитать наши заметки о том, как написать петицию. Эта страница содержит несколько предложений по написанию петиции.
Указания приведены здесь: {HOW_TO_CREATE_LINK}.
How can I convince people to sign my petition?
Spread the petition by telling your friends. Telling to others is the primary weapon.
Мы также рекомендуем вам расширить возможности дискуссионных форумов и групповых обсуждений.
Кроме того, посылайте электронную почту значительному числу людей, которых вы знаете, интересуют петиции, или людям, которым вы считаете, что по крайней мере заинтересованы. (Но не отправлять спам!).
We also invite you to use our bookmarking service that is on top of each petition.
Networking sites like Facebook and Twitter are also a good window for your petition.
Petitions in social networks run very quickly between people who, as you, are interested in a topic, such as in groups.

Чтобы продвигать вашу петицию также является хорошей практикой размещать ссылки на других сайтах. Обратите внимание на то, что так как многие веб-сайты будут содержать ссылку на вашу петицию больше поисковых систем узнают ее как важную страницу, и больше она будет посещаться. Поэтому мы рекомендуем поместить ссылку как можно больше сайтов. Хорошим способом распространения может быть вставка ссылки в базы данных как Wikipedia.org.

You should be looking for sites that have similar aspects to the subject of your petition. You will agree once you've identified them to send emails to their webmaster and probabily they will insert the link of your petition. You can also click on the Bookmark link found at the top of each petition and refer to other social networks, where you can promote your petition.
Как мне поставить ссылку, которая указывает на FreeCause?
As with any other links, copy the address bar of your browser and paste it wherever you want.
Or grab the embedding code on every page you will find petitions and paste it into the html code of your site.
Donations to FreeCause. How can I do a donation?
Перейдите на страницу пожертвований в верхнем меню, там вы найдете всю необходимую информацию для отправки пожертвования.
Страниц {DONATIONS_LINK}
FreeCause it is an independent site that holds only thanks to donations from users.

how-to-write-a-petition.title: Как написать петицию
content: Introduction

Each of us, those who for one reason or another, feel compelled to protest against something and want to act. Some want their politicians to resign from their role, while others want to express their support for a politician, and some want that their favorite TV program would be again on air and still others want to see their favorite band's music in their hometown.
Many of us also believe in something and have values. Online Petition takes care to ensure that these values are not violated and the rights doesn't be violated.
The nature, economics and politics and human rights are at the center of our attention.
Write a petition is not as difficult as you might think.

Many activists have won their battle with Online Petition, that is, using our platform, which is simple and powerful. It's hard to say exactly what makes that a petition is signed by many people and reach the result. In some cases it is just luck. In other it's time. However, it is possible to draw some general principles and guidelines for writing a good petition.
Руководства по написанию хорошей петиции
Here are some of the best tips from the team of Online Petition:

• Пишите ваше заявление четко и лаконично. Многие из возможностей подписчиков вашей петиции зачастую не имеют в их распоряжении много времени. Важно, чтобы во вступительной части петиции основное внимание было уделено краткому изложению этой цели. В первом абзаце необходимо указать цели, которые призвана достичь петиция.
• Проверка орфографии

On many sites you are not worried at all to do spell check of the petition was posted online. If you want that people take seriously your petition, you have to spend a bit of your time to ensure that the form is correctly edited and especially proposed to the public in a serious and professional way.
• Используйте "Интернет" для его рассеивания.

Advertise and promote your petition using email and social networking sites like Facebook and Twitter. You will be surprised at the ability to disseminate and publicize of the social networks. Also ask to all your contacts to tell about your petition to their friends. This form of advertising called "viral marketing" is the most effective way to advertise a topic on the web.
• Try to be respectful of others!

It is important that you express clearly the objectives in the text of the petition. Try to do it but in a way that respects the ideas of others. Many potential signatories, while supporting the objectives are often annoyed by petitions that are offensive in their content.
• Specify your objectives
Indicate precisely what are the objectives of your petition and for what purpose you will use the petition. Indicate to whom is directed the petition.
• оффлайн продвижение петиции

The fact that you have created an online petition does not mean you just promote it only on web sites. You can also promote your petition in your daily life. There are many ways to promote it at home, at work, and in many other places where you can collect more signatures. For example, through posters in the libraries of your city, or even doing promotion at work and making people aware that you have created a promotion on a certain topic.

privacy-policy.title: Политика конфиденциальности
content: Заявление о конфиденциальности

FreeCause recognizes the importance of your privacy and your right to control your personal information. We understand that providing personal information is an act of trust, and we take this responsibility seriously. This Privacy Policy forms part of our Terms of Use (TOU) and should be read in conjunction with them.
Приватность по электронной почте
Your email address will never be displayed publicly on this website.
• Мы не будем отправлять вам письма, не относящиеся к FreeCause.
• Если указано, ваш адрес электронной почты будет храниться безопасно.
• If you sign a petition, you may receive a signature receipt by email for your records. This receipt includes information on how to edit and manage your signature.
• Your email address may be used for signature verification during quality control to maintain high standards of integrity in signature lists.
Использование вашей информации
FreeCause will not sell or share your personal information with any third party, except as described in this policy.

• Petition Authors: If you sign a petition, your information will be accessible to the petition’s author. Authors agree to use this information responsibly and in compliance with our Terms of Use and this Privacy Policy. Authors may contact you about the campaign you supported or forward petition signatures to the petition’s target. Petition targets may view signature details. Authors are prohibited from republishing signatures on other websites or media platforms.
Общедоступное отображение подписей и комментариев
• Your signature (and any accompanying comment) may be publicly displayed in the petition’s signature list. Public lists do not include email or street addresses but may include your town or city.
• Petition authors have the option not to display their lists publicly. However, assume that the list may be displayed unless explicitly stated otherwise.
• You can use our "Anonymous" designation feature to cloak your name and hide your signature from public view. Comments can also be hidden from public view if desired.

• Please note that search engines (e.g., Google) may index publicly visible signatures and comments. To prevent indexing, cloak your signature and hide your comment. Users can edit their signatures and comments to manage search engine exposure. Instructions are available in our FAQ.
Facebook Comments

If you use the Facebook comment feature on a petition, your name and profile photo may appear on the FreeCause site. This feature is powered by a Facebook plugin. FreeCause does not guarantee that attempts to edit Facebook comments will achieve the desired results. Using this feature is at your own risk.
Advertising and Cookies
FreeCause использует куки для улучшения работы пользователей и поддержки сайта. Кроме того, мы работаем с рекламными партнерами, такими как Google и просто реклама:

• Google DART Cookie: Google, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies to serve ads on this site. These cookies enable ads tailored to your visits to our site and others. You can opt out of the DART cookie by visiting Google’s ad and content network privacy policy.
• Cookies также используются для сохранения ваших предпочтений и улучшения функциональности сайта . Согласие на куки управляется согласно действующим законам.
Signature Details and Personal Information

Signatures include the signer’s IP address, which is accessible to the petition’s author and FreeCause administrators for security purposes. Other personal information collected during the signing process will be treated in compliance with international data protection standards.
Доступ к данным и права пользователя
FreeCause respects your rights to access, edit, or delete your personal information. You can:
• Запросить доступ к вашим данным.
• Редактировать свою подпись или комментарии.
• Запрос на удаление вашей персональной информации.
Эти запросы будут обрабатываться оперативно и в соответствии с действующим законодательством. В некоторых случаях могут применяться административные сборы .
Сохранение данных

Personal data is retained only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy or as required by law. Data related to petitions may be stored to maintain the integrity of campaigns and support quality standards.
Безопасность

FreeCause takes appropriate measures to secure personal information, including encryption and regular security assessments. However, no system is completely secure, and users should exercise caution when sharing personal data online.
Деловые переводы

If FreeCause or substantially all of its assets are acquired, or in the event of bankruptcy, user information may be transferred as part of the transaction. Any acquiring party will continue to use your information as described in this policy. Users will be notified of any significant changes.
Общение от FreeCause
• Обновления пищи: Если вы подписали петицию, вы можете получать обновления , относящиеся к поддерживаемой вами кампании.
• Related Communications: Occasionally, you may receive information about related petitions, site updates, or account-related notifications.
• You can manage your email preferences or opt out of communications at any time.
Children’s Privacy

FreeCause does not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under the age of 18. If we become aware that a child’s personal information has been collected, we will take steps to delete it promptly.
Updates to this Privacy Policy

Эта политика может периодически обновляться, чтобы отразить изменения в нашей практике или юридических требованиях . Пользователи будут уведомлены о важных обновлениях по электронной почте или по уведомлениям на сайте.
If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at Contacts.

privacy-policy-12.title: Политика конфиденциальности
content: Заявление о конфиденциальности

Freecause признает важность вашей конфиденциальности и ваше право контролировать вашу личную информацию. Мы понимаем, что предоставление личной информации является актом доверия, и мы серьезно относимся к этой ответственности. Данная Политика конфиденциальности является частью Условий использования (TOU) и должна быть прочитана вместе с ними.
Email Privacy
Ваш адрес электронной почты будетникогда небудет публично отображаться на этом сайте.
• Мы не будем отправлять вам письма, не относящиеся к Freecause.
• Если указано, ваш адрес электронной почты будет храниться безопасно.
• Если вы подпишете петицию, вы можете получить квитанцию по электронной почте для ваших записей. Эта квитанция включает информацию о том, как редактировать и управлять вашей подписью.
• Ваш адрес электронной почты может быть использован для проверки подписи во время контроля качества для поддержания высоких стандартов целостности подписи списков.
Use of Your Information
Freecause will not sell or share your personal information with any third party, except as described in this policy.

• Авторы петиции:Если вы подписываете петицию, ваша информация будет доступна автору петиции. Авторы обязуются использовать эту информацию ответственно и в соответствии с нашими Условиями использования и настоящей Политикой конфиденциальности. Авторы могут связаться с вами по поводу кампании, которую вы поддерживаете, или направить подписи петиции к цели петиции. Целью подачи заявок может быть просмотрена информация о подписях. Авторам запрещается перепубликовать подписи на других сайтах или медиаплатформах.
Публичное отображение подписей и комментариев
• Your signature (and any accompanying comment) may be publicly displayed in the petition’s signature list. Public lists do not include email or street addresses but may include your town or city.
• Авторы петиций имеют возможность не показывать их списки публично. Однако, предположим, что список может быть отображен, если не указано обратное.
• You can use our "Anonymous" designation feature to cloak your name and hide your signature from public view. Comments can also be hidden from public view if desired.

• Пожалуйста, обратите внимание, что поисковые системы (например, Google) могут индексировать публично видимые подписи и комментарии. Чтобы предотвратить индексацию, поместите подпись и скрыте комментарий. Пользователи могут редактировать свои подписи и комментарии для управления экспозицией поисковых систем. Инструкции доступны в нашем FAQ.
Facebook Comments

If you use the Facebook comment feature on a petition, your name and profile photo may appear on the Freecause site. This feature is powered by a Facebook plugin. Freecause does not guarantee that attempts to edit Facebook comments will achieve the desired results. Using this feature is at your own risk.
Advertising and Cookies
Freecause использует куки для улучшения пользовательского опыта и поддержки функций сайта. Кроме того, мы работаем с рекламными партнерами, такими как Google и просто реклама:

• Печенье Google DART:Google, как сторонний поставщик, использует куки для показа объявлений на этом сайте. Эти файлы cookie позволяют размещать объявления в зависимости от ваших посещений нашего сайта и других сайтов. Вы можете отказаться от использования DART cookie, посетив политику конфиденциальности рекламы и контентной сети Google.
• cookies также используются для сохранения ваших предпочтений и улучшения функциональности сайта. Согласие на cookies управляется в соответствии с действующим законодательством.
Подробности о подписи и личной информации

Signatures include the signer’s IP address, which is accessible to the petition’s author and Freecause administrators for security purposes. Other personal information collected during the signing process will be treated in compliance with international data protection standards.
Доступ к данным и права пользователя
Freecause respects your rights to access, edit, or delete your personal information. You can:
• Запрос доступа к вашим данным.
• Edit your signature or comments.
• Запросить удаление вашей персональной информации.
Эти запросы будут обрабатываться оперативно и в соответствии с действующим законодательством. Административные сборы могут применяться в некоторых случаях.
Data Retention

Personal data is retained only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy or as required by law. Data related to petitions may be stored to maintain the integrity of campaigns and support quality standards.
Security

Freecause takes appropriate measures to secure personal information, including encryption and regular security assessments. However, no system is completely secure, and users should exercise caution when sharing personal data online.
Business Transfers

If Freecause or substantially all of its assets are acquired, or in the event of bankruptcy, user information may be transferred as part of the transaction. Any acquiring party will continue to use your information as described in this policy. Users will be notified of any significant changes.
Communication from Freecause
• Обновления Пети:Если вы подписываете петицию, вы можете получать обновления, связанные с кампанией, которую вы поддерживаете.
• Связанные Коммуникации:Иногда вы можете получать информацию о связанных петициях, обновлении сайта или уведомлениях, связанных с аккаунтом.
• Вы можете управлять своими предпочтениями по электронной почте или отказаться от общения в любое время.
Children’s Privacy

Freecause does not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under the age of 18. If we become aware that a child’s personal information has been collected, we will take steps to delete it promptly.
Updates to this Privacy Policy

Эта политика может периодически обновляться, чтобы отражать изменения в нашей практике или правовых требованиях. Пользователи будут уведомлены о важных обновлениях по электронной почте или по уведомлениям на сайте.
If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@Freecause.com.

terms-of-service.title: Условия предоставления услуг
content: FreeCause User Agreement

"Пользователь" относится к любому лицу, которое загружает любые материалы на сервер или с сервера FreeCause . "Пользователь" включает в себя, но не ограничивается этим, Авторы петиций, Сторонние участники форума (любой, кто разместил на форуме кто не является членом), лица, которые комментируют любые свойства сайта FreeCause , и петиционеры.
"Member" means any person who authors a petition on the FreeCause site or any person who joins the FreeCause community by opening an account.

"Moderate", "moderated content", "moderation" refers to a process by FreeCause where content is reviewed on a random sampling basis or due to comments or feedback by 3rd parties. FreeCause uses a part active, part passive moderation regime. Active moderation is conducted primarily on a random sampling basis. Passive moderation results from feedback by 3rd parties. Due to the massive volume of content posted to FreeCause, not all content can be reviewed actively, and therefore a large amount of content is automatically posted. FreeCause does not warrant that any specific petition(s) or forum comment(s) has been actively moderated, reviewed or even seen by a human being.

"Approved" petitions may simply have passed through a review period and may NOT have been actively moderated, or even viewed, by a human being. Active human moderation is primarily done on a random sampling basis.
TOS:
(1). User/Member Agreement: In consideration of being allowed to use the website facilities provided by FreeCause, Users/Members agrees that Users/Members will not:
A. Используйте петицию или форум для любых целей в нарушение местного, штата или национального законодательства любой страны;
B. Post material that is copyrighted, unless User/Member owns them or has the permission of the copyright owner to post it;
C. Post material that reveals trade secrets, unless User/Member owns them or has the permission of the owner of the trade secrets to post it;
D. Post material that infringes on any other intellectual property rights of others or on the privacy or publicity rights of others;

E. поставлять материалы, которые разумным лицом могут толковаться как угрожающие, непристойный, диффамация, необоснованные, оскорбления, домогательства, или ненависти к другому пользователю/члену или любому другому лицу или организации.
F. Размещение рекламы или запросов бизнеса;
G. Post цепочка писем или схем пирамиды;
H. Impersonate another person.

I. Submit false User/Member information when opening an account or signing a petition. FreeCause reserves the right to edit, change or remove an account, petitions or signatures or any other information when untruthful or inaccurate User/Member information is supplied. This includes but is not limited to Name, Address, City, State, zip (post) code and e-mail address. Members may post petitions or comments anonymously or by using a username (nickname) to protect identity as long as such usage does not conflict with the terms of use herein. FreeCause reserves the right to ask a petition author to confirm their identity and provide their residential or business address. Failure to furnish this inforamtion upon request may result in account closure.

FreeCause also reserves the right to ask a petition author (whether an individual or organization) to publish a contact person (real name) on the relevant petition. Such a request can be made at the absolute discretion of FreeCause. A request may be made, for example, because FreeCause believes that legal issues exist beteween the parties of a nature that demands identity transparency. FreeCause encourages ADR (Alternative Dispute Resolution) procedures and this is often best served with a transparency policy. Failure to comply with a request from FreeCause for identity transparency may result in account closure.

J. Signature Management and Signature Edits. Members must not edit a signature in any way that compromises the intent of the signer. Petition authors agree to edit signatures only to remedy a spelling or grammatical error, remove an obscenity or remove spam, or delete illegal material.

K. Members must use signature lists (including email addresses) responsibly, legally and in compliance with our Privacy Policy which forms part of these Terms. Members undertake not to spam their signature list. Members may forward their signature list to their petition's target but must not re-publish their petition's signature list on their own or any 3rd party website. Republication of signatures is in breach of our terms, our intellectual property rights (see Term (4) below), and our privacy undertaking to signers.
L. Не будет удерживать FreeCause ответственным за последствия любого доступа поисковой системы к деталям из списка публичных подписей.

M. Upload a petition about any issue that is currently before the courts, or will soon be before the courts, or use a petition as an instrument to engage in pre-litigation or litigation positioning. Petitions must not discuss evidence before the courts or show contempt of any court in any jurisdiction. A petition may not lobby court official in any matter that is before the courts. A petition cannot lobby jurors or make any comment about them. A petition should not, as a general rule, lobby state or federal prosecutors or judges.

N. Заявки не должны свидетельствовать о неуважении к суду или судьям любой юрисдикции. Обращения не должны разграничивать ни одного судьи, DA, lawyer, барристер или юридический сотрудник независимо от того, являются ли такие обвинения истинными или нет.

O. Petition authors may not use bots or automated scripts to upload signatures or other data to the FreeCause server, unless express permission is supplied by FreeCause. A breach of this term may result in a petition or account being disabled or closed.

P. Hold FreeCause liable in relation to third party search engine activity. Listings of FreeCause content by search engines are possible because FreeCause has a general data transparency policy. To balance this policy, FreeCause has a rigorous Privacy Policy which enables data control and data protection. Urgent requests to search engines for content removal can be made by users to those search engines through the various request channels of those search engines.

Q. In the interests of signers and site moderators, authors shall not engage in excessive editing of their petitions. Signers' trust in the information that signers have endorsed must be respected. In this respect, each petition author agrees not to change the substance of their petition(s). Authors agree not to change the essential meaning of their petition(s) so that fairness is displayed to all signers. Any editorial changes to petitions must only be of a grammatical, stylistic or non-substantive basis. If substantial changes are needed for any petition, we encourage the relevant petition author to start a fresh petition which can then be promoted to signers of previous versions for approval.

R. Petitions against neighbors, or petitions that involve disputes with neighbors who are individuals (not business or government entities) are generally not permitted at FreeCause. Petitions against local school teachers, school principals, school superintendents, school directors or administrators are generally not permitted at FreeCause. Please use local neighborhood mediation services to resolve these types of disputes. In addition, petitions against local police officers or law enforcement personnel are not permitted. Internet petitions are often not appropriate in these cases. FreeCause does not warrant that petitions on these subject matters will not appear on the FreeCause website. This clause is primarily for campaign guidance.
(2). Что касается адреса электронной почты участника:
A. A Member's email address will never be displayed publicly by FreeCause. FreeCause has a strict privacy policy that can be viewed on this website.
B. Members will normally receive email alerts regarding mail sent to their FreeCause mailbox. This alert feature may be switched off at any time by a member.
C. Members may receive periodic emails from FreeCause which relate to site functions.

(3) (a) Members agree that their petition(s) and member profile(s) may be stored in perpetuity in the FreeCause database. Members agree that if a petition is closed it will be publicly archived for signers to see the results. A closed version of all petitions will remain live on the site. Archived petitions allow for data access by signers and targets. Members are not be permitted to forward a closed petition to another petition site either by way of URL forwarding or by notation (text direction).

(b) Members acknowledge that the signature list URL can be made available by them and sent (emailed) to the petition target for viewing of the signature list at any time and on completition of the petition. Members acknowledge that this method of signature list delivery shall be sufficeint for the purposes of signature list presentation. Members acknowledge that file downloads and backups are available with premium services.

(с) Участники признают, что они несут ответственность за собственное содержание и любые комментарии или четыре комментария, связанные с их петициями. Члены с петициями модерируют комментарии, связанные с их петициями(ями), и сообщает о злоупотреблениях FreeCause в случае их информирования.

(4). License and copyright: By posting petitions and other communications, User/Member grants to FreeCause a royalty-free, perpetual, irrevocable exclusive license to use, reproduce, modify, moderate, publish, translate, distribute, perform and display those communications, inclusive of signatures, alone or as part of other works in any form, media, or technology whether now known or hereafter developed. FreeCause reserves any and all intellectual property rights, including copyright or otherwise, attached to the publication of petitions, authored by members, on the FreeCause website. Publication of a petition at FreeCause does not automatically confer copyright to the owner. Copyright of a petition text, if required, should be stated specifically in the petition where copyright is required. FreeCause shall retain copyright over all signature lists generated on the FreeCause website.

(5). Indemnity: Every User/Member agrees to hold harmless FreeCause and its officers and directors from any and all claims, actions or demands, resulting from User/Member material or personal information posted to any facilities provided by FreeCause. Members, including petition authors, agree to indemnify FreeCause for any legal claims against FreeCause resulting from member content posted on the FreeCause website, or any content endorsed by a member on the member's petition. The indemnity shall include all legals costs pre, during and post litigation resulting from any action by an agrieved party. The indemnity operates regarldless of whether the legal action is successfully defended by FreeCause or not. All and any court costs orders, regardless of a case's outcome, are included in this indemnity.

Listings of FreeCause content by search engines such as Google are the responsibility of those engines as FreeCause has a general data transparency policy. FreeCause, however, allows and encourages Members to control their own data. FreeCause seeks to balance the interests of data transparency, data control, Privacy, data access and search engine exposure for the benefit of our members and the general public. FreeCause's Privacy Policy forms part of this TOU.

(6). Users and Members are subject to the FreeCause Disclaimer. The Disclaimer forms part of these Terms. The FreeCause Privacy Policy is also subject to the Disclaimer and TOU. The Privacy Policy forms part of these Terms.

(7). FreeCause at its absolute discretion may release member or signer contact and other identifying details to third parties without notice or reasons to the member or signer. This clause would be occasionally invoked, for example, when FreeCause forms an opinion that the release of such information would be fair or equitable or may help in a legitimate legal investigation, criminal or civil.
(8). By subscribing to or using the Services, User acknowledges and agrees that FreeCause is entitled to transfer User’s personal data to third parties.

If FreeCause, or substantially all of its assets were acquired, or in the unlikely event that FreeCause goes out of business or enters bankruptcy, user information would be one of the assets that is transferred or acquired by a third party. You acknowledge that such transfers may occur, and that any acquirer of FreeCause may continue to use your personal information as set forth in this policy and that there may be changes to the policy.

(9). Construction: Nothing in the Terms and Conditions shall be construed as reducing or limiting FreeCause's rights or interests as set forth in the Disclaimer, or as expanding FreeCause's duties, obligations or liabilities beyond those provided for in the Terms and Conditions.
(10). FreeCause reserves the right to amend or change these terms of service so as to improve the services of FreeCause.

(11). While the services of FreeCause are generally free, we reserve the right to place a sponsor's advertisement on the same page as a Member's petition. We also reserve the right to post a sponsor's url on a Member's petition. FreeCause also offers premium services on a non-refundable fee basis.

(12) FreeCause may charge for premium services, on a non-refundable basis, which may vary from time to time according to FreeCause's discretion, use of server or administrative resources, and/or service availability. Premium service accounts with petitions that have massive signature counts may attract additional charges due to extra loads on server resources. FreeCause may request the payment of premium services on an account at its discretion. Such requests may be made, for example, in circumstances where FreeCause forms the view that excessive administrative resources have been applied to an account.

(13). FreeCause has the right to moderate site content so that FreeCause's Terms are complied with. Due to the magnitude of content on the site, FreeCause does not warrant that all content is actively moderated. FreeCause does not warrant that its moderation of content complies with the laws of relevant jurisdictions. FreeCause has the right to remove any site content, including petitions and forums, without notice or reasons. Any content removal shall be at FreeCause's absolute discretion. Authors may submit a request for removal of petition information, subject to FreeCause's diescretion and an administrative fee. Petition or content removal may attract an administrative charge.
(14). FreeCause не обязательно поддерживает какой-либо сайт или рекламодатель на сайте. Реклама, обслуживаемая роботом Google, не выбрана FreeCause.

(15). The terms herein shall be governed by the protections afforded by the Supreme Court of California to blog sites against claims for libel or copyright infringement. This website is not liable for any such infringements in relation to materials uploaded by members or users. Redress against member content lies with direct claims against members, authors and/or users, not this website.

(16). FreeCause является премиум контент-сайтом. FreeCause согласен предоставить умеренный сайт премиум-контента, который отображает и улучшает петиции локальных, национальное и международное значение для улучшения интересов наших членов.
